watson: Use case: identity-preserve. Acting reference sheet for existing 56x64 classic pixel adventure portrait. Reference image defines exact identity, age, hair, face proportions, costume, warm restricted ochre palette and 3/4 right-facing camera. Same person, same scale/head position in all panels. Remove gold frame for sheet only; dark aubergine background. Crisp coarse native pixel clusters, no smooth rendering or caricature. NINE equally sized busts in 3 columns by 3 rows. Top row: neutral (copy reference), warm (restrained smile directly underneath the moustache, creased eyes), puzzled (brows up and inward, slight frown). Second row: concerned (raised inner brows), surprised (eyes wider, brows high), resolute (set jaw, firm eyes). Bottom row: moustache smoothing gesture START: hand entering from lower right, bent forearm visible and wrist connected through period cuff; MIDDLE: index finger lightly brushes beneath near half of moustache; END: fingers smooth toward the outer moustache tip. During habit keep head, mouth, hair absolutely stationary; articulate whole arm and hand coherently. Small labels below each panel. Habits must be complete rerendered bust poses with natural anatomy, not separate limbs pasted onto base.
